note: Tester-first test families. Every family groups checklist items so a tester can work an attack surface without losing context. dont_miss entries are coverage reminders for experienced testers, not tutorial content. Validator gates: items resolve, membership is unique per category, and every production item of a family-covered category belongs to exactly one family.

families.title: Role & permission matrix
families.summary: Establish the expected function, object, field, tenant, and workflow permissions before mutating anything.
dont_miss: Document object, function, field, tenant, and workflow permissions separately, not one blended role list
Include groups, delegated permissions, service identities, and tenant roles, not only named user roles
Re-verify the matrix after any role, membership, or tenant changes during the engagement

families.title: Object-level authorization
families.summary: Per-object read, update, delete, collection, bulk, nested, indirect, media, report, and async-result decisions.
dont_miss: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE against the same object identifier, not just the read path
Nested and child objects reached through parent identifiers
Bulk, batch, and multiplexed endpoints that authorize only the first member
Export, report, download, and asynchronous job-result equivalents of the same object
Indirect and opaque references, signed URLs, and media retrieval paths
Search and filter endpoints that evaluate queries before object authorization
Rechecking authorization after the object's state changes

families.title: Function-level authorization
families.summary: Which callers may invoke a function at all: unauthenticated, alternate methods, admin, undocumented, versioned, and error paths.
dont_miss: Alternate HTTP methods, route aliases, and trailing or versioned routes to the same handler
Administrative and management functions from a standard user context
Undocumented or newly deployed functions that inherit default access
Error, preview, and metadata representations that bypass normal authorization
Client-side hidden buttons and disabled UI treated as access controls

families.title: Privilege, role & field boundaries
families.summary: Client-controlled roles, ownership reassignment, protected property writes, delegated scope, revocation, and field-level visibility.
dont_miss: Role, permission, owner, tenant, price, and status fields written by lower-privilege callers
Membership changes to groups, teams, and shared resources by non-owners
Delegated and shared access that outlives its intended scope or expiry
Revocation and role removal while stale caches or self-contained claims survive
Field-level reads that reappear in sparse, expanded, or alternate representations

families.title: Tenant isolation & integration boundaries
families.summary: Tenant context binding, cross-tenant object access, switching state, invitations, and confused-deputy integrations.
dont_miss: Tenant identifiers supplied in the body, headers, subdomains, and cookies instead of trusted identity
Cross-tenant object access through shared identifiers, caches, and indexes
State, drafts, and permissions leaking when a user switches tenants
Privileged backend integrations performing operations for a caller without downstream authorization

families.title: Workflow, approval & audit boundaries
families.summary: State-transition authorization, separation of duties, impersonation, existence oracles, realtime channels, and audit behavior.
dont_miss: Out-of-order, skipped, or replayed workflow state transitions
Approvals performed by the same identity that requested the action
Administrator impersonation and support access without layered re-verification
Authorization answers leaking object existence through error or timing differences
Realtime channel subscriptions and messages carrying authorization of their own
Audit events that themselves disclose protected data

families.title: Credential transport, logging & defaults
families.summary: Where credentials travel and whether defaults, logs, or referrers expose them.
dont_miss: Login, enrollment, recovery, and factor submissions over plaintext or downgraded channels
Credentials, OTPs, and recovery tokens in query strings, paths, and referrer-bearing navigation
Documented vendor defaults on the confirmed product, including API and appliance logins

families.title: Account enumeration
families.summary: Whether login, registration, and recovery disclose which accounts exist, through text, timing, or status codes.
dont_miss: Response text, status codes, redirects, headers, and body shape differences
Repeatable timing differences between valid and invalid accounts
Registration and username-reminder flows disclosing existing identities
Recovery flows confirming account existence before any email is sent

families.title: Username & password policy
families.summary: Canonicalization, length, composition, and rotation rules for passwords and usernames.
dont_miss: Case, whitespace, and Unicode normalization differences between registration and login
Hidden truncation of long passphrases at creation or verification
Paste and password-manager blocking on security-sensitive fields
Breached, common, and context-specific password rejection
Forced periodic rotation driving predictable password cycling

families.title: Brute force & credential stuffing
families.summary: Guessing and stuffing controls across account, device, network, and risk signals, including lockout abuse.
dont_miss: Per-account limits that survive source-IP and device rotation
Credential stuffing across distributed sources with breached-credential screening
Account lockout used as a denial-of-service primitive against other users

families.title: Login enforcement & fail-closed
families.summary: Authentication on every route and representation, consistent across methods and media types, failing closed on errors.
dont_miss: Direct navigation, API calls, alternate formats, and nested resources bypassing the login gate
Method or media-type changes reaching unauthenticated parsers and handlers
Omitted, duplicated, and ambiguous authentication fields
Malformed requests and unavailable identity services granting access or skipping factors

families.title: Password change & account recovery
families.summary: Current-password requirements, token generation, reset-link origins, and account binding across change and recovery flows.
dont_miss: Password changes without the current password from an unattended session
Account identifiers in change requests that can target another user
Reset tokens that are predictable, reusable, or long-lived
Reset links built from Host or forwarding inputs instead of a canonical origin
Reset completion bound to the wrong account, factor, tenant, or action
Knowledge-based security questions used as an authentication factor

families.title: MFA & factor lifecycle
families.summary: Enrollment, completion, OTP verification, recovery codes, factor removal, and push-approval behavior.
dont_miss: Factor enrollment without recent reauthentication
MFA completion skipped through direct routes, flow fields, or session reuse
OTP and recovery-code guessing within their validity windows
Replayed or reused OTPs and push approvals
Factor removal or replacement with only weak session proof
Push fatigue and approval prompts without number matching or context

families.title: Trusted devices & persistent login
families.summary: Remember-device and remember-me tokens: entropy, rotation, revocation, and exemption binding.
dont_miss: Guessable or low-entropy persistent-login tokens
Remember-me tokens surviving logout, password changes, and explicit revocation
Trusted-device exemptions that outlive factor or password changes

families.title: Step-up & account lifecycle
families.summary: Bootstrap expiry, reauthentication for sensitive actions, security-event notifications, and secret-free audit logging.
dont_miss: Bootstrap passwords and activation codes reused after first login
High-risk account, financial, and administrative actions relying only on an old session
Missing notifications for password resets, factor changes, and suspicious logins
Audit logs that record credentials instead of outcomes

families.title: Passkeys & federation boundaries
families.summary: Passkey binding and challenge verification, alternate-channel strength, and local fallback beside federated login.
dont_miss: Mobile, legacy, API, and support channels with weaker assurance than the primary login
Local passwords or break-glass routes bypassing required SSO or MFA
Passkey registration and assertions bound to the wrong account, origin, or relying party
Password recovery silently disabling MFA or downgrading assurance

families.title: API object & field authorization
families.summary: BOLA and BOPLA across reads, mutations, nested resources, bulk calls, mobile clients, and property filtering.
dont_miss: Read, update, delete, and cancel mutations against swapped object identifiers
Parent, child, tenant, and relationship identifiers validated together
Each member of a bulk or batch request receiving its own authorization decision
Identifiers recovered from mobile clients reaching other accounts and tenants
Protected fields writable through mass assignment or broad model binding
Fields reappearing in sparse, expanded, or alternate representations

families.title: API authentication & credentials
families.summary: Credential transport consistency, key scoping, audience binding, and equivalent strength across versions and protocols.
dont_miss: Absent, malformed, duplicated, and alternate credential transports accepted inconsistently
Long-lived shared API keys embedded in public clients with excessive scope
Tokens issued for another API, client, tenant, or purpose being accepted
Legacy versions, RPC routes, and mobile endpoints with weaker authentication

families.title: Schema & binding
families.summary: Per-action writable schemas instead of shared model binding, and response overfetching beyond the contract.
dont_miss: Create, patch, replace, and admin actions sharing an overbroad binding model
Backend returning complete records that client-side filtering hides

families.title: Resource & abuse controls
families.summary: Page sizes, body and batch limits, expensive queries, paid side effects, and distributed abuse.
dont_miss: Pagination and expansion parameters driving disproportionate database, memory, or bandwidth use
Oversized JSON, XML, multipart, arrays, and operation batches processed before rejection
User-selected filters, sorts, and joins with unbounded backend cost
Requests triggering unbounded email, SMS, exports, or third-party spend
Parallel and distributed requests bypassing per-account budgets

families.title: API function authorization
families.summary: Admin-only functions, route aliases, role and membership management, and default-deny for new functions.
dont_miss: Standard tokens invoking admin operations discovered through schemas, clients, or traffic
Alternate verbs, aliases, and versioned routes reaching privileged handlers
Lower roles assigning roles, groups, service accounts, invitations, or membership
Undocumented and newly deployed functions inheriting generic access

families.title: Business flows & transaction state
families.summary: Automation of high-value flows, workflow sequence, and idempotency or one-time semantics.
dont_miss: Purchasing, reservation, posting, invitation, and redemption flows automatable beyond intent
Clients skipping, replaying, or reordering required workflow transitions
Replayed or retried requests duplicating transactions, credits, bookings, or side effects

families.title: URL fetching & third-party integration
families.summary: Server-side fetch parameters, redirect revalidation, and the security of consumed third-party APIs.
dont_miss: Import, webhook, avatar, preview, and callback URLs reaching unintended destinations
Allowed URLs redirecting or resolving to prohibited targets after validation
Third-party API fields treated as trusted commands, identity, price, role, or markup
Slow, oversized, or malformed upstream responses exhausting resources or failing open
Upstream TLS identity, redirect policy, and credential scoping

families.title: Operations & exposure
families.summary: Method and media-type handling, debug output, CORS, and management endpoints.
dont_miss: Unused methods or parser fallbacks exposing operations or weaker validation
Production errors disclosing code paths, queries, secrets, or debug functions
API responses readable from untrusted origins with ambient credentials
Documentation consoles, actuator, metrics, and admin tooling without access controls

families.title: Inventory & lifecycle
families.summary: Host and version inventories, deprecated versions, shadow deployments, and documentation reconciliation.
dont_miss: APIs without an owner, environment, data class, or lifecycle state
Deprecated versions remaining reachable with weaker controls
Development, staging, preview, and mobile hosts exposing unmanaged copies
Schemas omitting live routes or describing retired authentication

families.title: Acceptance & validation
families.summary: The documented contract and how extension, media type, signature, and size limits are enforced together.
dont_miss: Extension, declared Content-Type, and file signature contradicting each other
Case, trailing dots and spaces, alternate separators, and Unicode filename normalization
Upload byte, file-count, and per-user storage quotas beyond the documented contract
Unpacked limits and retention boundaries, not just the raw upload size

families.title: Execution & sandboxing
families.summary: Server-side execution, isolated serving origins, and malware scanning placement.
dont_miss: Uploaded content routed through server-side executable handlers
Active formats inheriting application cookies, origin privileges, or inline rendering
Malware scanning treated as type validation instead of defense in depth

families.title: Naming, collisions & headers
families.summary: Filename traversal, overwrite and collision behavior, and Content-Disposition safety.
dont_miss: Chosen names or predictable storage keys replacing another user's file or an application asset
Multipart and metadata filenames escaping the staging directory
Download filenames injecting headers or breaking quoting in Content-Disposition

families.title: Archive handling
families.summary: ZIP Slip, symlink escape, and expansion bounds during extraction.
dont_miss: Archive entry paths escaping the extraction root
Symlink and hardlink entries redirecting later reads and writes
Unpacked bytes, ratios, depths, and entry counts exceeding safe bounds

families.title: Image & document processing
families.summary: Decoded dimensions, metadata, SVG handling, polyglots, and privileged previews.
dont_miss: Small encoded images expanding to excessive pixels or memory
Metadata, embedded active content, and secondary streams surviving processing
SVG scripts, events, links, and external references in the preview pipeline
Polyglot files valid in multiple formats bypassing one validator
Privileged moderation and admin previews processing untrusted files with greater access

families.title: Authorization & retrieval
families.summary: Who may attach, download, and derive files — including traversal on download and export paths.
dont_miss: Uploading into another user's object, tenant, folder, or privileged slot
Changed file IDs, storage keys, or transformations retrieving private files
Traversal through download and export path parameters
Encoded and double-decoded traversal variants across edge and application decoding
Partial uploads, scan queues, and failed files remaining publicly reachable

families.title: Inclusion & generated content
families.summary: Local and remote inclusion, untrusted template loading, and generated files that inherit unsafe input.
dont_miss: Local path selectors loading unintended server-side files into processing
Include, template, theme, and plugin selectors fetching and evaluating remote resources
Server-generated PDFs, spreadsheets, and archives inheriting unsafe filenames or active content

families.title: Discovery & search indexing
families.summary: Publicly indexed assets, certificate transparency, robots, sitemaps, and well-known resources.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Check certificate transparency logs for historical and current hostnames, not only live certificates
Treat robots and sitemap entries as leads; verify every candidate against the live application
Review well-known resources for security contacts and identity metadata

families.title: DNS, hosting & non-production
families.summary: Authoritative records, resolved boundaries, approved ports, non-production hostnames, and dangling references.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Record mail, alias, and delegation records alongside A and CNAME entries
Correlate every resolved address with the approved hosting boundary before probing
Reconcile admin, dev, staging, and preview hostnames with scope and ownership
Identify dangling CNAME and NS targets without ever claiming them

families.title: Server & TLS fingerprinting
families.summary: Web-server hypotheses and TLS certificate relationships from response characteristics.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Rate server fingerprints by confidence instead of trusting a single header
Treat certificate names as endpoint relationships, not automatic scope

families.title: Applications & routing
families.summary: Distinct applications behind hostnames, base paths, virtual hosts, and default-site behavior.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Separate tenant portals, management surfaces, and route roots sharing one hostname
Compare approved Host values for routing and default-site behavior

families.title: Content & JavaScript extraction
families.summary: HTML comments, metadata, first-party script route extraction, and source-map classification.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Record hidden fields and disabled markup as reachable-attack-surface leads
Extract routes and service origins from script literals and request constructors
Classify source maps without treating readable client code as a finding

families.title: Surface mapping
families.summary: Forms, parameters, routes, methods, and multi-step workflow state transitions.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Inventory constraints, submission targets, and encodings per form
Deduplicate parameters across URL, body, headers, and cookies with example values
Distinguish read, mutation, upload, authentication, and administrative routes
Document valid workflow states, prerequisites, and rollback paths

families.title: Identity & account flows
families.summary: Authentication, reauthentication, step-up entry points, and account-lifecycle flows.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Catalog every route that establishes, refreshes, elevates, or re-verifies identity
Map registration, invitation, recovery, and account-change flows before targeting them

families.title: API & realtime discovery
families.summary: API roots, documentation, GraphQL endpoints, and WebSocket or SSE channels.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Build the API inventory from observed traffic before consulting documentation
Compare owner-published schemas against actually deployed operations
Confirm GraphQL transport modes, content types, and subscription channels
Catalog WebSocket handshake URLs, subprotocols, and authentication transport

families.title: Frameworks & intermediaries
families.summary: Server-side frameworks, packaged applications, CDNs, proxies, and edge-versus-origin behavior.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Fingerprint frameworks with corroborating cookies, headers, paths, and error forms
Identify packaged applications and CMS versions with multiple non-invasive markers
Model request hops and trust boundaries across proxies, CDNs, and application tiers
Compare edge and suspected origin behavior without bypassing scope

families.title: Third-party & browser state
families.summary: External script and identity dependencies plus browser storage and configuration namespaces.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Document external origins that receive data, execute in the page, or provide identity
Catalog localStorage, IndexedDB, and cache namespaces used by the application

families.title: Entry points & error families
families.summary: Upload, search, and reporting entry points plus error-response classification.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Include import, export, preview, and conversion routes in the entry-point inventory
Map search, filtering, sorting, and reporting inputs before testing them
Classify error families to guide later differentiation between vulnerable and benign

families.title: Attack-surface register
families.summary: Test matrices and the confirmed in-scope register that anchors the engagement.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Link test identities to roles, tenants, ownership states, and reachable functions
Keep the attack-surface register updated as scope changes during the engagement

families.title: HTTP methods
families.summary: Unsupported-method rejection, safe-method side effects, and method override handling.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Check unsupported methods on every route, not just the documented endpoints
Confirm GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS never trigger security-sensitive state changes
Test override headers and body parameters for unauthorized verb selection

families.title: Content types & encoding
families.summary: Declared media types, accurate responses, and MIME-sniffing boundaries.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Send bodies under undeclared, ambiguous, or conflicting Content-Type values
Compare declared media types and charsets against actual response bytes
Test whether sniffing can reinterpret user-controlled responses as active content

families.title: Path & parameter normalization
families.summary: Dot segments, repeated separators, duplicate parameters, and decode boundaries.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Probe dot segments, repeated separators, case, and trailing delimiters
Check whether path or parameter decoding happens more than once
Resolve duplicate parameters consistently across every hop

families.title: Target & host authority
families.summary: Absolute-form targets, Host versus :authority, and forwarding-header trust.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Send absolute-form and authority-form targets and observe routing changes
Compare HTTP/1 Host and HTTP/2 authority validation for the same route
Verify forwarding headers only influence state when an authenticated proxy sent them

families.title: Redirects & HTTPS
families.summary: User-controlled redirects and plaintext entry paths.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Test redirect parameters, paths, and headers against attacker-controlled origins
Map plaintext entry paths and verify canonical HTTPS redirection without mixed content

families.title: CORS
families.summary: Origin allowlists, credentialed access, opaque origins, preflights, and exposed headers.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Distinguish reflected origins from exact allowlist decisions
Test credentialed CORS reads with ambient cookies and HTTP authentication
Reach sensitive operations through simple requests that skip preflight
Review Access-Control-Expose-Headers for secret-bearing names

families.title: Caching
families.summary: Persistent caches, shared-cache partitioning, cache keys, and Vary metadata.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Verify sensitive representations are not stored in persistent or shared caches
Test whether a CDN or reverse proxy can serve one user representation to another
Probe unkeyed query fields, headers, and cookies for cache poisoning
Check Vary distinguishes representations shaped by safe request headers

families.title: Conditional & protocol translation
families.summary: Conditional and range requests, compression oracles, and framing translation.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Reauthorize If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since, and Range requests for protected resources
Assess compression oracles where reflected secrets share compressed responses
Verify edge-to-origin protocol translation rejects ambiguous message framing

families.title: Token inventory & transport
families.summary: Session-token discovery and URL or referrer exposure.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Inventory cookies, headers, body fields, and client stores that carry session state
Check paths, queries, redirects, browser history, and Referer for token leakage

families.title: Cookie attributes
families.summary: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, Domain, Path, and persistent lifetime.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Verify Secure on every authentication-bearing cookie
Confirm HttpOnly unless script access is genuinely required
Choose SameSite against the real cross-site authentication flow
Minimize Domain and Path scope to avoid sibling-host exposure
Bound persistent cookie lifetime to the documented server-side risk policy

families.title: Token properties
families.summary: Entropy and plaintext sensitivity of client-visible session values.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Verify session identifiers are unique and unpredictable across issuance events
Check session values for usernames, roles, internal IDs, or secrets

families.title: Fixation & rotation
families.summary: Pre-authentication fixation, post-auth rotation, and privilege-change rotation.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Confirm attacker-chosen pre-login identifiers never survive authentication
Verify login replaces and invalidates every pre-authentication token
Rotate session authority after role elevation, impersonation, and step-up

families.title: Lifecycle & logout
families.summary: Concurrency, logout invalidation, revocation, idle and absolute timeouts, and server-side expiry.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Enforce concurrent-session limits consistent with account risk
Verify captured tokens stop working after logout
Confirm users can review and revoke other active sessions
Test idle timeout from server-observed activity, not client timers
Verify absolute maximum lifetime survives continuous refresh activity

families.title: Identity & account changes
families.summary: Disablement, deletion, password or factor changes, and account switching.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Confirm disabled or deleted identities lose all sessions and persistent tokens
Offer session termination after password or factor changes
Verify logout/login and account switching leaves no prior identity state

families.title: Puzzling & isolation
families.summary: Multiple token names, sibling-application isolation, and explicit session creation.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Swap, omit, and mix parallel session values to select another identity
Verify tokens from one application are rejected by sibling applications
Confirm cross-site navigation cannot silently create application sessions

families.title: Federation & distribution
families.summary: Coordinated logout, revocation propagation, and refresh-token family replay.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Coordinate relying-party and identity-provider logout semantics
Verify revocation reaches APIs, gateways, workers, and regional services
Detect replay of rotated refresh or persistent token families

families.title: Client storage
families.summary: Reusable session authority in script-readable storage.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Evaluate localStorage and IndexedDB bearer tokens against the XSS surface and lifetime

families.title: SQL injection
families.summary: Detection, confirmation, identifiers, second-order, ORM, bulk, and asynchronous SQL paths.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Confirm every differential with paired predicates, never a single error
Test ORDER BY, identifiers, and stored-value paths beyond string positions
Verify parameterization across bulk, array, and asynchronous report inputs

families.title: NoSQL injection
families.summary: Operator injection, auth bypass, blind predicates, server-side JavaScript, pipelines, and second-order fragments.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Probe operator objects in structured JSON bodies
Pair blind response predicates before concluding NoSQL injection
Test aggregation and projection pipelines plus stored query fragments

families.title: LDAP injection
families.summary: Filters in authentication lookups, directory searches, and DN construction.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Test authentication lookups and directory search filters separately
Escape distinguished-name construction independently from filters

families.title: XML, XPath & entities
families.summary: Predicate injection, structure injection, external entities, DTDs, and XInclude.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Pair XPath predicates to confirm node-set differences
Test element and attribute value positions for structure injection
Verify external entities, parameter entities, and XInclude are all disabled

families.title: Command injection
families.summary: Separators, blind timing, argument injection, filenames, workers, and environment influence.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Use inert output markers before timing-based confirmation
Test argument injection without shell metacharacters
Probe filenames, upload metadata, and asynchronous worker paths
Constrain environment and executable-path influence

families.title: Template & expression injection
families.summary: SSTI detection, context classification, stored and blind variants, sandboxes, includes, and dynamic evaluation.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Classify the template context before choosing syntax
Test stored and blind template paths with controlled callbacks
Probe sandbox boundaries without attempting host escape
Cover expression-language and dynamic-evaluation equivalents

families.title: Header, log & mail injection
families.summary: CRLF into headers and redirects, log sanitization, and email header injection.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Test response-header and redirect Location CRLF positions
Sanitize untrusted values before structured logging
Verify generated email messages cannot inject additional headers

families.title: Parameter pollution
families.summary: Duplicate-parameter rules and cross-source pollution.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Apply one duplicate-parameter rule across security controls and parsing
Test cross-source pollution between query, body, cookies, and headers

families.title: Export & host injection
families.summary: Spreadsheet formulas, CSV quoting, Host validation, link origins, cache keys, and forwarded values.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Neutralize spreadsheet formulas in exported user data
Preserve CSV boundaries and quoting during export
Validate Host before routing and security decisions
Build password and invitation links from a canonical origin
Ignore untrusted forwarded host and scheme values

families.title: Mail, regex & SSI
families.summary: SMTP and IMAP injection, regex injection and ReDoS, and server-side includes.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Test recipient fields for SMTP command injection
Escape untrusted text embedded in regular expressions
Bound catastrophic backtracking with long adversarial inputs

families.title: Reflected & stored XSS
families.summary: Input classification, stored user content, and blind stored payloads in privileged views.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Classify the reflection context before choosing a payload
Confirm stored XSS with an isolated observer account
Detect blind stored variants in privileged review surfaces

families.title: DOM & storage XSS
families.summary: Location sources, postMessage, and browser-storage values reaching executable sinks.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Trace URL-derived flows from location sources to executable sinks
Validate postMessage origin and payload before DOM insertion
Keep browser-storage values out of executable DOM sinks

families.title: Sinks & sources
families.summary: API and realtime message encoding, dangerous HTML and JavaScript sinks, and URL schemes.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Encode API and WebSocket message data at the final DOM sink
Remove innerHTML-style sinks for untrusted values
Reject unsafe URL schemes in navigation and resource sinks

families.title: Sanitization
families.summary: Configuration bypasses, mutation XSS, rich text, SVG, and Markdown transformations.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Test sanitizer configuration and nesting bypasses
Detect mutation XSS after browser reparsing
Constrain active content in user-supplied SVG
Sanitize Markdown and rich-text output on the trusted boundary

families.title: Frameworks & templates
families.summary: Framework escape hatches, client-side templates, and JSONP.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Keep framework escape hatches away from untrusted content
Prevent client-side template injection reaching script execution
Validate JSONP callback names or remove JSONP entirely

families.title: Uploads & encoding
families.summary: Active upload files and character-encoding normalization.
dont_miss: Checklist items in this family must be re-verified across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
Serve uploaded active files outside the application origin
Normalize character encoding before validation and output
